Name: 6480's Giant Crops
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: Adds giant versions of many vanilla crops.
Description:
This mod is a collection of images used for [More Giant Crops](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263)﻿, and adds giant versions for 17 vanilla crops that act just like giant melons, pumpkins, and cauliflower. In addition, it also includes a Content Patcher retexture of the vanilla giant cauliflower and melon!

The crops included in this mod are:
Nonregrowable/single-harvest - Potato, red cabbage, starfruit, sweet gem berry, beet, radish, yam, artichoke, parsnip, garlic.
Regrowable/multi-harvest - Coffee, ancient fruit, corn, tomato, pepper, strawberry, eggplant.

**Giant versions of regrowable crops WILL replace your crops! **This means if you have a field of, say, ancient fruit and a giant ancient fruit grows in the field, you will lose your already-grown ancient fruit plants and need to replant them at that spot. This works as intended and is not going to be changed.**If you do not want this to happen, DO NOT install the folder called "Regrowable Crops".**

Coming soon: All other non-flower single-harvest vanilla crops. And blueberries.

This mod does not include any flowers! If you're looking for giant flowers, I recommend checking out [Neo's Giant Flowers](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6653)﻿.

Install guide:
For: "Non-Regrowable Crops" and "Regrowable Crops":
- Download and install [SMAPI](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI) and [More Giant Crops
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263)- Download the files from this mod and open them using an unzipping program
- Drag the folder(s) called "assets" into your /Mods/More Giant Crops folder
- You're done!

For: "Giant Melon and Cauliflower Retexture":
- Download and install [SMAPI](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI) and [Content Patcher
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)- Download the file from this mod and open it using an unzipping program
- Drag the folder called "[CP] Giant Melon and Cauliflower Retexture" to your /Mods folder
- You're done!

Uninstall guide:
Break every modded giant crop existing in your game, then delete the images for all the giant crops you want to get rid of from the folder /Mods/More Giant Crops/assets.
